module_title: Introduction to the Insurance Sector and IRDAI
introduction: Insurance is essentially a tool for 'Risk Management'. When you buy insurance, you transfer the financial risk of a potential future loss to an insurance company in exchange for a fee.

core_concepts.title: Two Main Types of Insurance
core_concepts.description:
1. Life Insurance: Covers the risk of a person's life. Payouts happen either upon death or maturity of the policy (e.g., LIC). 
2. General Insurance: Covers everything other than life, such as vehicles, homes, health, and travel. It operates purely on the principle of 'Indemnity' (compensation for actual loss).

core_concepts.title: IRDAI (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India)
core_concepts.description: It is the apex statutory body regulating and developing the insurance industry in India. It was constituted by the IRDA Act of '1999' based on the recommendations of the 'Malhotra Committee'. Its main job is to protect policyholders from corporate fraud.

core_concepts.title: Premium
core_concepts.description: The specified amount of money that you (the policyholder) must pay periodically (monthly, annually) to the insurance company to keep the insurance coverage active.

important_entities.name: IRDAI Headquarters
important_entities.significance: While most financial institutions (like RBI, SEBI, SBI) have their headquarters in Mumbai, IRDAI's headquarters is uniquely located in Hyderabad. This is an extremely common trivia question in exams.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: A common conceptual trap: People treat insurance as a wealth-building tool. In pure economics, insurance is strictly a tool for 'Protection'. While products like ULIPs combine both, the primary economic definition of insurance is risk mitigation, not profit generation.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: IRDAI was formed in 1999 based on the Malhotra Committee.

exam_strategy_tips: When was LIC established? Answer: September 1, 1956. It is India's largest and oldest state-owned life insurance and investment corporation.
